But Google > counts total volume too, so the server throttles itself: `max_searches_per_hour` > (default 60) and an exponential CAPTCHA cooldown. > - A Google CAPTCHA no longer ends the call. Google goes on a shared cooldown > and the same query is answered by the next engine in `search_engines` > (DuckDuckGo, Brave, Bing, and optionally a self-hosted SearXNG by default). > `data.engine` reports who answered and `data.attempts` lists every attempt. > In visible (`xephyr`) mode the challenge window is left on screen so you can > solve it yourself; `last_captcha_at` and `engine_cooldowns_s` in > `health_check` show the current state. Recovery is worth waiting for: > sustained barrages end in CAPTCHA regardless of pacing, so if every engine > is cooling down, wait a few minutes and retry. > - opencode + subagents: SAFE.
